info.title: Kiosk AI API
info.description: Kiosk AI Backend API. Covers Health, QR codes, Upload, Payment (Stripe), Products, and Admin (auth, orders, dashboard, settings, Stripe settings).

tags.name: QR Code
tags.description: QR code generation, validation, and details

tags.description: Image upload, check status, and image retrieval

tags.name: Payment
tags.description: Stripe config and create payment intent (checkout)

tags.name: Admin - Orders
tags.description: List orders and get order details

Bearer.name: Authorization
Bearer.description: Enter your JWT token in the format: Bearer {token}

get.description: Service health and uptime (served at root /health, not under /api).
Returns publishable key, currency, and active status for checkout (no auth required).

post.description: Creates a Stripe Payment Intent for checkout. Returns clientSecret for Stripe Elements.
